items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Tiny Bradshaw had a very popular band during that time. They would use our band for maybe three weeks and then bring Tiny Bradshaw's band in for three weeks.

ctx.x: The summer of '41, we took the band to Columbus, Ohio and we played at a place called the Club Lincoln. We had a good-sounding band. And we played there twice during that summer. We played there early summer, then we went back and played late summer. Club Lincoln was a nice little club, there and they would have nice crowds on the weekends and during the week.
